economic_hypothesis: In a causally observable broad BULL state, a moderate twenty-session advance built through many small positive sessions and relatively little downside turnover represents distributed demand rather than a single attention shock. The first non-limit, high-location, moderately expanded-turnover close above the already known twenty-session ceiling may begin a further repricing leg. TRANSITION is excluded because the earlier frozen mother screen showed that the same stock pattern has different economics when broad participation and direction are not jointly positive.
relationship_to_v26: V26 succeeds because an objective low-inventory structure exists before entry and the later event only confirms that demand has started to traverse it. This experiment applies the same hierarchy rather than copying the true-gap signal: the prior twenty-session path defines distributed ownership and limited downside supply before the breakout; the completed escape is the demand confirmation. No true-gap, V26, V27, support, limit-up, or industry-laggard identity is reused.
post_hoc_disclosure: The parent 2014-2020 BULL and TRANSITION aggregate outcomes were already observed. Choosing BULL-only for this deeper anatomy is a data-generated development decision, not independent confirmation. No 2021 or 2022-2024 signal outcome may define chart rules.

mother_signal.market_route: BULL only, using the registered signal-close causal state: market median ret20 and ret60 are both greater than zero and their positive-return shares both exceed 50 percent
mother_signal.history: exact prior sixty completed market sessions, valid and contiguous in one corporate-action coordinate lineage
mother_signal.distributed_path: at least 60 percent of the prior twenty sessions are positive; maximum absolute session return is strictly below 7 percent
mother_signal.selling_supply: prior-twenty downside-turnover sum divided by upside-turnover sum is at most 0.65
mother_signal.escape: completed signal return is 2 to 7 percent, close location at least 75 percent, and coordinate close strictly exceeds the known prior-twenty high
mother_signal.participation: signal turnover is 1.2 to 2.5 times the prior-twenty median
mother_signal.limit_rule: signal close is not the registered upper price limit
mother_signal.cooldown: first raw event after more than twenty completed market sessions without another raw distributed-accumulation event

baseline_translation_for_chart_labels.entry: first legal non-upper-limit open in the next three market sessions, strictly after the signal
baseline_translation_for_chart_labels.time_stop: after thirty held market sessions, then the first legal sellable open

chart_protocol.review: open every chronological nine-up sheet and record repeated winner and failure structures before freezing any rule
questions: Was the twenty-session advance a genuine base escape or the last leg of a mature six-month run?
Did repeated small gains reflect stable accumulation or low-liquidity drift?
Was the old ceiling a clean nearby inventory boundary or embedded in repeated overhead supply?
Did the signal create immediate accepted price discovery or an isolated terminal demand candle?
Was the causal BULL state newly broadening, mature, or short-horizon exhausted at the decision close?
